patterns.note: Asymmetric layout for hero and feature sections, where large, editorial-style photography occupies a significant portion of the screen, with text content positioned off-center or in a smaller, distinct block.
Consistent use of a single clean sans-serif typeface across all text elements, with variations in size and weight to establish hierarchy, and small uppercase text used for labels and subheadings.
A muted and earthy color palette derived primarily from high-quality photography, complemented by a stark white background and black text for high contrast and a sophisticated feel.
The main hero image is fixed in the background, creating a parallax-like effect as subsequent content sections scroll over it, revealing more of the image before it eventually scrolls out of view.
Product display sections utilize a clean, consistent grid layout with individual product cards featuring a product image, name, and price, maintaining ample white space around each item.

technique_notes: To rebuild the hero section, use a full-bleed background image that is set to `background-attachment: fixed;` so it remains stationary while other content layers scroll over it. Position the main heading and call-to-action text absolutely or with a z-index above this fixed background.
The site employs a sticky header navigation that remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, ensuring constant access to primary navigation links.
A cookie consent bar appears at the bottom of the viewport and remains sticky, providing persistent information and interaction options.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, clean sans-serif headings (~2-3x body) with smaller, often uppercase, supporting text, creating a clear visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for main blocks and containers, with very subtle rounding (e.g., 4px) applied to product cards and interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and feature sections, balanced in product grids, emphasizing visual breathing room and a premium feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, editorial-quality photography as fixed backgrounds that content scrolls over, combined with an asymmetric layout and a clean, minimal aesthetic, elevates the product presentation beyond a typical e-commerce site, creating a sophisticated and aspirational brand experience.
